# Financials in Visuals repository instructions

Before any action, read root `AGENTS.md`, `project-status.json`, `site/research_catalog.json` and the complete canonical Skill `skills/ashare-financial-storytelling/SKILL.md`, then the playbooks in `skills/ashare-financial-storytelling/playbooks/` that the task needs. The five manuals in `skills/ashare-financial-storytelling/research/01..05` are background evidence.

Treat the Skill as a must-execute research and visualisation contract: one catalog-driven library, standalone HTML per report, source-cell-backed facts, exact accounting identities, lawful chart grammar, shared renderers only, native desktop and phone figures. Independent human finance and visual review is `NOT_CHECKED` unless documented. `docs/NEW_SESSION_PROMPT.md` is the ChatGPT new-chat boot instruction; repository files do not guarantee automatic Skill loading in an ordinary ChatGPT conversation.
